(rule!
 ;; A spanning colored wall supplies the first interlocking contours. Translate
 ;; loose same-color pieces without rotation. A whole leading contour must touch
 ;; one predecessor's exposed interface; a flat edge is not an interlock.
 ;; Each placed piece exposes the next contour. Chains may grow on either side.
 ;; Backtrack locally matching placements that leave a later piece unplaceable.
 ;; Background is black. Erase loose source copies and preserve the wall.
 (lambda (g)
   (let ()
     (define source-wall (first (filter (lambda (o) (or (= (obj-h o) h) (= (obj-w o) w))) (objects g 0))))
     (define vertical (= (obj-h source-wall) h))
     (define board (if vertical (transpose g) g))
     (define hh (rows board))
     (define ww (cols board))
     (define obs (objects board 0))
     (define wall (first (filter (lambda (o) (= (obj-w o) ww)) obs)))
     (define pieces (filter (lambda (o) (not (equal? o wall))) obs))
     (define ids (range (length pieces)))
     (define local (map (lambda (o) (normalize-cells (obj-cells o))) pieces))
     (define (profile i side)
       (let ((cells (list-ref local i)))
         (for/list ((j (range (obj-w (list-ref pieces i)))))
           (apply (if (= side 1) min max)
             (map first (filter (lambda (p) (= (second p) j)) cells))))))
     (define initial (recolor-cells (empty-grid hh ww 0) (obj-cells wall) (obj-color wall)))
     (define owners0 (recolor-cells (empty-grid hh ww -1) (obj-cells wall) 0))
     (define state
       (let loop ((pending ids) (out initial) (owners owners0) (depths (map (lambda (i) 0) ids)))
         (if (null? pending) (list out owners depths)
           (let ()
             (define upper (for/list ((c (range ww))) (apply min (filter (lambda (r) (not (= (at out r c) 0))) (range hh)))))
             (define lower (for/list ((c (range ww))) (apply max (filter (lambda (r) (not (= (at out r c) 0))) (range hh)))))
             (define candidates
               (for*/fold ((found '())) ((i pending) (side '(-1 1)) (cc (range (+ 1 (- ww (obj-w (list-ref pieces i)))))))
                 (let* ((o (list-ref pieces i)) (pp (profile i side))
                        (edge (take (drop (if (= side 1) lower upper) cc) (obj-w o)))
                        (rr (- (+ (first edge) side) (first pp)))
                        (moved (map (lambda (p) (list (+ rr (first p)) (+ cc (second p)))) (list-ref local i)))
                        (contact (remove-duplicates (for/list ((j (range (obj-w o)))) (at owners (list-ref edge j) (+ cc j))))))
                   (if (and (> (apply max edge) (apply min edge))
                            (= (length contact) 1)
                            (or (= (first contact) 0) (= (obj-w o) (obj-w (list-ref pieces (- (first contact) 1)))))
                            (andmap (lambda (j) (= (+ rr (list-ref pp j)) (+ side (list-ref edge j)))) (range (obj-w o)))
                            (andmap (lambda (p) (and (<= 0 (first p)) (< (first p) hh) (<= 0 (second p)) (< (second p) ww)
                                                    (= (at out (first p) (second p)) 0))) moved))
                       (cons (list i moved (+ 1 (if (= (first contact) 0) 0 (list-ref depths (- (first contact) 1))))) found)
                       found))))
             (for/or ((step candidates))
               (let* ((i (first step)) (cells (second step)) (depth (third step)))
                 (loop (remove i pending)
                       (recolor-cells out cells (obj-color (list-ref pieces i)))
                       (recolor-cells owners cells (+ i 1))
                       (map (lambda (j) (if (= i j) depth (list-ref depths j))) ids))))))))
     (define result (first (or state (error 'assembly "No complete interlocking assembly"))))
     (if vertical (transpose result) result))))
